[SWS_SwCluC_CONSTR_03546] Multiplicity of provided ComIPdus
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈Sent ComIPdu shall be provided to at most one Application Software Clus-
ter.⌋
In addition, the Com Proxy does not support a fan out of ComIPdus sent or received
via transport protocol API.
Please note that the PduR supports a fan-out of TP-connections to upper layers.
